command:
set -eu
root=$PWD
work=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR}/packed-observed957.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/pack" "$work/consumer"
node scripts/package-payload/CheckPackagePayload.ts --pack-destination "$work/pack"
sha256sum "$work"/pack/*.tgz
cd "$work/consumer"
npm init -y >/dev/null
npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=15000 "$work"/pack/*.tgz >/dev/null
sed -e "s#'../../../../index.ts'#'@git-stunts/git-warp'#" -e "s#'../../../../advanced.ts'#'@git-stunts/git-warp/advanced'#" "$root/test/integration/application/fixtures/ObservedWriterProcess.ts" > writer.mjs
sha256sum writer.mjs
node --input-type=module -e "import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import {realpathSync} from 'node:fs';const r=createRequire(import.meta.url);const p=realpathSync(r.resolve('@git-stunts/git-warp/package.json'));if(!p.startsWith(process.cwd()+'/node_modules/'))throw new Error('consumer escaped installation');console.log('installed artifact:',p);"
cli="$work/consumer/node_modules/@git-stunts/git-warp/dist/bin/git-warp.js"
clock() { git -C "$1" show --format=%B --no-patch "refs/warp/L/writers/$2" | sed -n 's/^eg-lamport: //p'; }
for format in sha1 sha256; do
 repo="$work/repo-$format"
 git init -q --object-format="$format" "$repo"
 git -C "$repo" config user.name 'packed observed witness'
 git -C "$repo" config user.email test@example.invalid
 node writer.mjs "$repo" a seed A19
 node "$cli" repair --repo "$repo" --lane L --writer maintenance --action materialization >/dev/null
 node writer.mjs "$repo" b observe A19
 observed=$(clock "$repo" a)
 node writer.mjs "$repo" b write B
 published=$(clock "$repo" b)
 test "$observed" -eq 21
 test "$published" -gt "$observed"
 node "$cli" repair --repo "$repo" --lane L --writer maintenance --action materialization >/dev/null
 node writer.mjs "$repo" reader observe B
 node writer.mjs "$repo" b write B-again
 restarted=$(clock "$repo" b)
 test "$restarted" -gt "$published"
 node "$cli" repair --repo "$repo" --lane L --writer maintenance --action materialization >/dev/null
 node writer.mjs "$repo" reader observe B-again
 echo "PACKED_OBSERVED_957 format=$format observed=$observed published=$published restarted=$restarted reading=B-again PASS"
done
cd "$root"
npm run typecheck:consumer
npm run check:package-payload
guard: inner guard plus outer host free/log monitor; read-only container root
